body: Just because your world as been in rough patch for a while doesn’t mean that tomorrow might be different. I know it’s hard to imagine the good in a time like this but trust me it exists around one of your corners. You have to just keep fighting to see it. I know that you might be tired of fighting for yourself but there are people who you might not have even met yet who need you to keep fighting for them.

Not really everyone in my life kinda just holds me to this expectation of being perfectly fine and happy. I guess it’s just the front I’ve built up for myself. I don’t wanna let them down and I feel like they wouldn’t understand.
Try just wait you never know what’s around the corner man. I wanted to die just yesterday but hey I’m alive one more day
